spec.name: Zawiya Kadiriya
spec.description: The Zawiya Kadiriya is one of the most important spiritual institutions in Ksar el-Kebir. It is unique for housing two distinct branches of the Kadiriya Sufi brotherhood, including the Bedouia branch. As a major center for the city's religious life, it preserves traditional Islamic learning and spiritual practices, featuring notable architecture and traditional Moroccan decor.

timeline.title: Establishment
timeline.description: Kadiriya order begins to take deep root in the spiritual fabric of Ksar el-Kebir during the Saadian period.
